## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security hardening

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] I have run `pytest` and all tests pass locally.
- [ ] I have added regression tests for any bug fixes.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation to reflect any changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private URLs are included in test fixtures.
- [ ] Safety defaults (read-only, write approvals, production blocks) are strictly preserved.
